chestradar.screen.title: Chest Radar
chestradar.screen.search_tip: name · ench: · id: · in: · kind: · dim: · >64 · m:32 · d:7 · -exclude
chestradar.screen.empty_hint: Open a chest: the mod remembers what's inside.
chestradar.screen.no_match_hint: Remove a word, or search further in the settings.
chestradar.screen.no_pins_hint: Middle-click an item to pin it.
chestradar.screen.sort.NAME: Name
chestradar.screen.click_hint: Click: look at the chest  ·  Right click: details  ·  Middle click: pin
chestradar.config.title: Chest Radar
chestradar.config.subtitle: Find any item stored in your chests, and the way there.
chestradar.config.face_container: Turn the camera towards the chest
chestradar.message.save_failed: Chest Radar: couldn't save your chests (another program may be blocking the file).
chestradar.message.no_item: Hold an item to search for it.
chestradar.pin.full: Chest Radar: %s pinned items max, remove one first.
chestradar.changes.header: %s · what changed since your last visit:
chestradar.config.hide_stale: Hide chests that are too old
chestradar.config.auto_purge: Forget chests that are no longer there
chestradar.config.slot_highlight: Show the item's slots in the chest
chestradar.config.look_at_preview: See what's inside by looking at a chest
chestradar.config.report_changes: Say what changed in a chest
chestradar.config.hint: Put your mouse on a setting to see what it does
chestradar.config.disabled: Doesn't work: a setting above is off.
chestradar.config.radius.tip: Chests further than this aren't shown. They're not forgotten: raise the distance and they come back.
chestradar.config.lore.tip: Also searches the lines written under an item's name. Very useful on servers.
chestradar.config.structured_search.tip: You can type filters: -word to remove, ench: for an enchant, >64 for an amount. Turn it off if your items have dashes or "word:" in their name.
chestradar.config.all_dimensions.tip: Also searches the Nether and the End. The dimension is written on those results.
chestradar.config.chat_limit.tip: How many chests are written in chat when you search with the key.
chestradar.config.auto_refresh.tip: Off, the mod never forgets anything by itself. You clear it when you want.
chestradar.config.show_last_seen.tip: Writes "seen 3 d ago" on each chest, so you know if the info is recent.
chestradar.config.stale_after.tip: After this time, the chest turns grey: what's inside may have changed. "never" = never grey.
chestradar.config.hide_stale.tip: Chests that are too old disappear instead of turning grey.
chestradar.config.auto_purge.tip: If you walk past a saved chest and it's gone, the mod forgets it.
chestradar.config.purge_interval.tip: How often the mod checks if chests are still there.
chestradar.config.highlight.tip: Draws an outline around the chests found. You can see it through walls.
chestradar.config.highlight_seconds.tip: How long the outline stays. The timer starts when you close the radar.
chestradar.config.highlight_labels.tip: Writes the chest name and how many there are, above the outline.
chestradar.config.label_distance.tip: Further away, the name isn't written, but the outline stays.
chestradar.config.slot_highlight.tip: After a search, when you open the chest, the slots with your item are coloured (also shulkers and bundles holding it).
chestradar.config.slot_highlight_seconds: How long the slots stay coloured.
chestradar.config.compass.tip: An arrow and the distance to the chest. Handy when the chest is behind you.
chestradar.config.arrival_distance.tip: Closer than this, you've arrived and the arrow goes away.
chestradar.config.face_container.tip: When you click a result, your camera turns to the chest. Off, it just gets an outline.
chestradar.config.look_at_preview.tip: Look at a saved chest: you see what's inside without opening it.
chestradar.config.preview_rows.tip: How many items are shown. For the rest, it says "+N".
chestradar.config.inventory_totals.tip: When you put your mouse on an item, it says how many you have in your chests. With Shift, you also see the closest chest.
chestradar.config.jade.tip: Shows the contents in Jade's box, so you don't get two boxes on top of each other.
chestradar.config.barrels.tip: Remembers what's in the barrels you open, like chests.
chestradar.config.shulkers.tip: Remembers what's in shulker boxes placed on the ground.
chestradar.config.hopper_gui.tip: Some servers open chests as a small menu. Turn this on to remember them anyway.
chestradar.config.bulk_quantity.tip: On some servers, one item counts as thousands (the real number is written on it). The mod reads that number instead of counting 1.
chestradar.config.nested.tip: Counts items in shulkers and bundles stored in a chest. Otherwise, a shulker full of iron counts as a shulker, not as iron.
chestradar.config.report_changes.tip: When you close a chest, the mod says in chat what was added or taken since your last visit.
chestradar.config.between_visits.tip: Only says what others changed. Turn it off to also see what you put in or took.
chestradar.config.change_limit.tip: The max number of lines for one chest.
chestradar.config.pins.tip: Middle-click an item to pin it: it stays at the top of the list. You can also say how many you need.
chestradar.config.panel_width.tip: The width of the radar window, in % of your screen.
chestradar.config.clear.tip: Erases everything the mod remembered for this world or server. You can't undo it. Your pinned items are kept.
chestradar.config.jade.requires: Doesn't work: needs Jade, and "See what's inside by looking at a chest" on.
chestradar.craft.title: Craft helper
chestradar.craft.tab_tip: Opens the craft helper. If you pick a recipe in the book first, it works on that one right away.
chestradar.craft.tab_tip_selected: For the chosen recipe: what you're missing, and which chests to get it from. Shift + click: for 64.
chestradar.craft.search: What do you want to craft?
chestradar.craft.quantity_tip: How many you want. Scroll or use the - / + buttons. Hold Shift to go by 64.
chestradar.craft.ready: You can craft it right now
chestradar.craft.no_recipes: No recipes: your recipe book is empty on this world.
chestradar.craft.match_hint: Click: for one craft  ·  Shift + click: for %s
chestradar.craft.route_tip.ready: Starts the route: the chests to go to, nearest first.
chestradar.craft.route_tip.in_hand: Nothing to fetch: everything is already on you.
chestradar.craft.route_tip.nowhere: Nothing to fetch: what you're missing isn't in any of your chests.
chestradar.craft.route_tip.disabled: Routes are turned off in the settings.
chestradar.craft.row_hint: Left click: take me there  ·  Right click: see how to craft this ingredient
chestradar.craft.tooltip_nowhere: Not in any of your chests.
chestradar.route.started: Route for %s: %s chests, %s items to take.
chestradar.route.other_dimension: %s chest(s) not counted: they're in another dimension.
chestradar.route.no_target: No pinned item has a number to reach: Shift + middle click to set one.
chestradar.route.pins_done: You already have everything in your inventory.
chestradar.screen.details_empty: Right-click an item to see which chests hold it.
chestradar.config.craft_planner.tip: For a recipe: what you're missing, and which chests have the rest. Works with the recipes your book knows.
chestradar.config.craft_tab.tip: Adds a small button under the inventory, crafting table and furnaces. You can also open it anywhere with the key.
chestradar.config.route.tip: Shows you the chests to go to for everything you're missing, nearest first. The arrow moves to the next chest when you arrive.
chestradar.config.route_stops.tip: Past that, the mod says the rest can't be found instead of sending you across the map.
chestradar.config.theme.tip: The same for all Aeternum mods: change it here and they all change.
